exact_result: In the entire retained smooth geometrically integral projective ample rational discretely valued domain, source-audited test-level orthogonality and strong approximation of every exact-mass finite-dual-energy target by genuine model Monge-Ampere measures; this does not construct the full E1 operator. In mixed characteristic, a genuine arbitrary-support E1 existence/uniqueness proof with raw mass (L^n), conditional on BOTH FGK2203.12282v2 Definitions 6.1 and 6.3 for all projective models of the original X. A proved finite-cover model-intersection example shows metric averaging does not commute with Monge-Ampere. Original P16.3 remains unsolved here.
concrete_gaps: Mixed characteristic: FGK projective regular domination of every model (Definition 6.1) and embedded resolution (Definition 6.3), or sufficient proved replacements on the original X, are not established in arbitrary dimension. Locally projective arithmetic resolution is not a checked substitute.
Equal characteristic p: no unconditional replacement for both resolution inputs in unrestricted total dimension d+n in the GJKM geometric-origin range.
Equal-characteristic complete discrete fields and varieties outside GJKM geometric origin: no general realization, envelope continuity or replacement compactness/regularization theorem is proved.

Full original potential-space realization: model-level strong density does not supply normalized compactness, genuine bounded discontinuous products, the compatible unbounded operator with weighted decreasing limits, all original C0-direction derivatives, actual attainment and uniqueness outside the explicitly conditional/scoped geometric theory.

No general finite/altered descent package is proved: finite-dual-energy pullback against all cover tests, invariant psh metric descent, cocycles, mixed local products, raw degree factors in inseparability, and the loss of ampleness for a nonfinite alteration remain obligations.
